global.d.ts.notes: The authorized ambient API has no complete runtime binding and conformance test yet; declaration presence is not treated as support.

node.d.ts.notes: Untrusted packages receive no ambient Node runtime. Individual compatible operations require an explicit brokered binding and test.

safari-ext.d.ts.notes: Safari extension declarations require a separately entitled, precompiled extension surface and are not currently bound.

scripting.d.ts.notes: The symbol is authorized for compatibility work but lacks a complete observable binding and conformance test.

web-fetch.d.ts.notes: A capability-gated network broker exists, but this declaration is not yet connected through the package runtime as a tested Web-compatible binding.

behaviorDifferences: The legacy checked-artifact ABI implements execute-tool registration, routing, cancellation and structured results; the full Scripting package compiler lane remains unavailable.
symbols.notes: Operational for integrity-checked legacy artifacts and intentionally not claimed as full namespace compatibility.

behaviorDifferences: Lifecycle contracts and resume delivery exist, but the TypeScript 7 package compiler cannot currently produce an installable runtime artifact on iOS.
symbols.notes: Lifecycle and resume infrastructure is implemented behind a blocked compiler/install gate.

behaviorDifferences: Namespacing, authorization and quotas are implemented; the generated JavaScript binding is not connected to an installable package runtime.
symbols.notes: Host broker implemented; end-to-end Scripting binding pending.

behaviorDifferences: Hanlin exposes a bounded package VFS instead of an ambient filesystem; external handles and the JavaScript binding remain incomplete.
symbols.notes: VFS host semantics are partial and deliberately deny raw paths.

behaviorDifferences: Modern Core Location live updates are implemented, but runtime binding and full declaration coverage are pending.
symbols.notes: Device adapter exists with explicit authorization paths.

behaviorDifferences: Authorization and scheduling adapter exists; the complete Scripting namespace is not bound.
symbols.notes: Host adapter implemented with denied and unsupported paths.

behaviorDifferences: Async HealthKit authorization and statistics are implemented for configured types; broad Health declarations remain unbound.
symbols.notes: Sensitive adapter exists behind both local grants and OS authorization.

behaviorDifferences: A precompiled generic widget renders a safe ScriptUI subset from snapshots; arbitrary package execution and unsupported nodes are excluded.
symbols.notes: Extension-safe snapshot transport is implemented; package compilation and device verification remain pending.

behaviorDifferences: Hanlin uses one static ActivityAttributes type and canonical package state; dynamic Swift types are impossible after installation.
symbols.notes: Generic lifecycle and renderer are present and require Xcode/device verification.

behaviorDifferences: One static AppIntent uses dynamic AppEntity records and foreground resume; installed packages cannot add new Swift AppIntent types.
symbols.notes: Generic dynamic action transport exists and requires Xcode discovery verification.
